dataList.name: Unending, Unavoidable Stream of Customer Complaints
dataList.desc:
"Cry of the Cocoon" is heard every "multiple of 3" turns

This unit cannot be immobilized in the turn "Cry of the Cocoon" is heard

dataList.flavor:
Voices seep from the cocoon.

"Anything under 80-count two-ply? Not even fabric!"
"Why aren't the buttonholes horizontal?"
"Jersey knit on machine? Really?"
"Why isn't the selvage red?"
"This hasn't even been shrink-proofed."
"Anything below Super 150 is cheap cloth, obviously."
"You think the Super scale is just yarn thickness? Diameter and yarn count aren't even the same thing. Don't you know that?"
"You're finishing the hem with a Union Special, right? Of course you are!"
"Is this Rigid? ... Oh. Selvage?"
"Wait... the stitch-per-inch count is way too even. You used a machine, didn't you?"
"It's not bespoke if it's not hand-stitched."
"... That's not even a Milanese buttonhole."
"Shirting needs to be over 200-count."
"Ugh, I can see the stitching on the outside."
"There, I can see two rows of stitching there. Rejected."
"What's with this seam finish?"
"Three-ply, minimum."

dataList.name: Roseate ชีพจร of Musculature
dataList.desc: เริ่มเทิร์น: At 15+ จำนวน [ChargeRouge], หากตัวละครนี้ does not have [Gourmandise], ผลาญ all จำนวน [ChargeRouge] ที่ตนเองมี และได้รับ [Gourmandise] ได้รับเอฟเฟกต์ต่าง ๆ ต่อไปนี้ while this unit has [Gourmandise]: - เมื่อใช้สกิล จะได้รับ +3 จำนวนครั้ง [Laceration] - On Hit จะได้รับ 1 [Laceration] - เมื่อถูกโจมตี on one of its Parts จะได้รับ 1 [BuffetSick] - เมื่อแคลชแพ้ จะได้รับ 3 [BuffetSick] - On Kill, หากเป้าหมายมี 3+ [BloodyMucus], generate "กายเนื้อที่ถูกฉีกของเทวชาด" ในเทิร์นถัดไป - Combat End: Heal 3 SP ตามทุก ๆ enemy that has [BloodyMucus] จบเทิร์น: หากตัวละครนี้มี 30+ [BuffetSick] when [Gourmandise] expires, ในเทิร์นถัดไป, weaken this unit's patterns and Stagger "กายเนื้อที่ถูกฉีกของเทวชาด" units on the field ※ [BloodyMucus] Stack can be reduced by the following means: E.G.O Skill Use and Defense Skill Use ※ "กายเนื้อที่ถูกฉีกของเทวชาด" gains [DeterioratingBody] เท่ากับ [BloodyMucus] on the defeated target ※ "กายเนื้อที่ถูกฉีกของเทวชาด" that has [DeterioratingBody] cannot be defeated ※ สูงสุดถึง 3 "กายเนื้อที่ถูกฉีกของเทวชาด" can be generated on the field
dataList.flavor: Its limbs thrash and twitch frantically as though they were never its own.

dataList.name: Disparity
dataList.desc: สร้างความเสียหายเพิ่มขึ้น +50% damage against slower targets
dataList.flavor: Everything in sight skitters around at disparate speeds.

dataList.name: Survival Instinct
dataList.desc:
เริ่มเทิร์น: ได้รับ 1 [SavePlacenta] and apply 5 [Protection] on the สายรก Part
หากตัวละครนี้มี [Gourmandise] หรือ if it is Staggered, this Passive does not activate
dataList.flavor: Consciousness has no hand in the body's struggles to survive and protect itself, which it does without even knowing where it begins and ends.

dataList.name: Severed สายรก
dataList.desc: จบเทิร์น: If the สายรก Part is broken, the Body Part gains 3 [Vulnerable] ในเทิร์นถัดไป
dataList.flavor: What are these dangling, floppy things attached to my body? Are these a part of "me"? It's so difficult to tell.

dataList.name: Rampage of a Violent, Traumatic Birth
dataList.desc:
จบเทิร์น: If the สายรก Part isn't broken, and at lower than 50% Core HP จะได้รับ [Gourmandise]
Then, does not lose [Gourmandise] Stack until the สายรก Part is broken
dataList.flavor: The body is torn from warmth into cold; the mind, from cool calmness to fiery chaos. None of it is voluntary.

dataList.name: Mindless ชีพจร
dataList.desc:
- When generated จะได้รับ [DeterioratingBody] เท่ากับ [BloodyMucus] Stack บนตัวเป้าหมาย that was defeated to generate this unit

Defeated when [DeterioratingBody] expires
dataList.flavor: It lives, yet it has no brain. Can the mind arise from pulsing muscle instead?
